name: PickerFields
description: A collection of PickerField objects. Each PickerField object represents a column definition of PickerDialog.

properties.name: Application
properties.description: Gets an Application object that represents the container application for the PickerFields object. Read-only.

properties.name: Creator
properties.description: Gets a 32-bit integer that indicates the application in which the PickerFields object was created. Read-only.

properties.name: Item
properties.description: Retrieves a PickerField object at the specified index. Read-only.

properties.name: Count
properties.description: Retrieves the count of the number of PickerField objects contained within the PickerFields collection. Read-only.
